# pve_vm_migrate (Action)

Migrates a QEMU VM to another cluster node (`POST /nodes/{node}/qemu/{vmid}/migrate`). The action waits for the migration task to finish. For running guests, `online` performs a live migration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.

# Live-migrate VM 100 from pve1 to pve2.
action "pve_vm_migrate" "migrate_vm" {
  config {
    node   = "pve1"
    vmid   = 100
    target = "pve2"
    online = true
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) The cluster node the VM currently runs on.
- `target` (String) The target cluster node.
- `vmid` (Number) The VM identifier. Must be between 100 and 999999999.

### Optional

- `bandwidth` (Number) Limits the migration bandwidth in KiB/s (`bwlimit`). A value of `0` resets the limit to the global setting.
- `force` (Boolean) Force the migration even against anti-affinity rules. Only root may use this option.
- `migration_network` (String) The CIDR of the (sub)network used for migration traffic.
- `migration_type` (String) The migration traffic type. Must be one of `secure`, `insecure`.
- `online` (Boolean) If set, performs a live migration of a running VM.
- `target_storage` (String) Overrides the target storage for local disks.
- `with_local_disks` (Boolean) If set, local disks are migrated to the target node.
